nodes.description: Public uint256 maximum number of NFTs that can be minted; mutable by owner via increaseMaxSupply and used as bound in mint functions.
Private current mint price (0.0001 ether initial) used in mintAlto payment check.
Private next mint price used when the saf price lifetime elapses in mintAlto.
Public price increment per token, owner-updatable and used in getPrice/nextSafPrice computation.
Public maximum price ceiling (0.3 ether) used by mintAltoCap and getPrice.
Public boolean sale toggle checked by mintAlto and mintAltoCap and flipped by flipSaleState.
Private timestamp of the last price refresh, written from block.timestamp.
Private duration controlling when the mint price is refreshed, owner-updatable via changeTimer.
Public provenance hash string written by setProvenanceHash.
Private address of the OpenSea ProxyRegistry used for operator whitelisting.
AltoCity constructor: sets maxSupply, proxyRegistryAddress, safPriceLifetime and initializes safPriceTimestamp from block.timestamp.
Payable mint that checks supply, count, sale state and price, refreshes price using block.timestamp, and mints via _safeMint to msg.sender.
Payable mint at priceCap; validates sale state, count, supply and exact ETH value then mints via _safeMint to msg.sender.
View helper returning the current derived price capped at priceCap.
Override whitelisting the OpenSea proxy registry operator, then falling back to ERC721 logic.
onlyOwner function performing unchecked maxSupply += _amount.
onlyOwner function minting one token to an arbitrary address via _safeMint.
onlyOwner loop minting tokens to addresses returned by backToCommunity() via _safeMint.
Private view 'randomness' derived from block.difficulty, block.timestamp and totalSupply.
Private view returning ownerOf(random() % totalSupply()).
onlyOwner setter writing ALTO_PROVENANCE.
onlyOwner setter forwarding the base URI to ERC721 _setBaseURI.
onlyOwner toggle of saleIsActive.
onlyOwner setter for priceStep.
onlyOwner setter for safPriceLifetime.
onlyOwner function splitting the contract balance 29/1 between owner and backToCommunity() using transfer.
Caller-controlled msg.sender, used as mint recipient and owner identity.
Miner-influenced block.timestamp used for price refresh and weak randomness.
_safeMint(msg.sender, mintIndex) inside the mintAlto loop, making an external callback to the receiver contract.
Native ETH transfer to msg.sender and payable(backToCommunity()) in withdrawAlto; external value transfer.
Unchecked state mutation maxSupply += _amount (Solidity 0.7 has no built-in overflow checks).
Weak randomness built from block.difficulty and block.timestamp, predictable/manipulable by miners.
_safeMint(payable(backToCommunity()), mintIndex) inside the airdrop loop, external callback to receiver.
_safeMint(payable(giveOwner), totalSupply()) in giveaway, external callback to receiver contract.
numberOfNfts parameter of mintAlto controlling how many tokens are minted.
numberOfNfts parameter of mintAltoCap controlling how many tokens are minted at priceCap.
_amount parameter of increaseMaxSupply added to maxSupply.
giveOwner parameter of giveaway, the recipient address of the free mint.
_dist parameter of airdrop, the loop iteration count.
provenanceHash parameter written to ALTO_PROVENANCE.
baseURI_ parameter forwarded to ERC721 _setBaseURI.
_step parameter assigned to priceStep.
timeInSeconds parameter assigned to safPriceLifetime.
mintIndex local (totalSupply()) used as the token id in mintAlto.
Loop counter i in mintAlto.
share local (balance/30) in withdrawAlto.
index local (random() % totalSupply()) used by backToCommunity.
mintIndex local (totalSupply()) used as the token id in airdrop.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient and is passed into _safeMint, allowing a malicious contract caller to re-enter during the token callback.
Caller-controlled msg.sender determines who receives the minted tokens and participates in the payment check.
block.timestamp decides whether the mint price is refreshed inside mintAlto, making price behavior miner/time dependent.
block.timestamp (with block.difficulty) is consumed as entropy by the weak randomness routine.
random() implements the weak randomness logic based on block.difficulty and block.timestamp.
backToCommunity() calls random() to choose an index, inheriting the timestamp/difficulty dependence.
withdrawAlto performs external ETH transfers to msg.sender and backToCommunity() before finishing.
Native value is transferred to msg.sender (the owner) via transfer, an external call that can invoke receiver logic.
withdrawAlto calls backToCommunity() (which in turn uses weak randomness) to compute the second recipient.
increaseMaxSupply mutates maxSupply with an unchecked addition, risking integer overflow.
The _amount parameter flows directly into the unchecked maxSupply addition.
_amount is the attacker-influenced operand of the unchecked overflow operation.
numberOfNfts controls the mint loop bounds and the totalSupply().add(numberOfNfts) supply check.
mintIndex local is derived from totalSupply() and used as the minted token id.
Loop counter i drives the number of _safeMint iterations in mintAlto.
mintAlto invokes _safeMint inside its loop, which performs an external receiver callback.
_safeMint triggers onERC721Received on the receiving contract, re-entering the mint logic while state is mid-update.
mintAlto reads maxSupply to validate the requested mint amount.
mintAlto reads safPrice to validate msg.value.
mintAlto reads and updates nextSafPrice when the price lifetime elapses.
mintAlto uses priceStep when recomputing the next price.
mintAlto reads and writes safPriceTimestamp to track the last price refresh.
mintAlto reads safPriceLifetime to decide whether to refresh the price.
mintAlto requires saleIsActive to be true before minting.
numberOfNfts parameter of mintAltoCap controls loop count and ETH value check.
mintAltoCap reads maxSupply for the supply bound check.
mintAltoCap requires saleIsActive before minting.
mintAltoCap multiplies priceCap by numberOfNfts for the exact payment requirement.
_dist parameter bounds the airdrop loop.
airdrop calls _safeMint in a loop, performing external receiver callbacks.
_safeMint in airdrop invokes onERC721Received on the recipient, allowing re-entry.
mintIndex local (totalSupply()) is used as the token id minted in airdrop.
airdrop calls backToCommunity() to choose the recipient of each minted token.
giveOwner parameter becomes the _safeMint recipient in giveaway.
giveaway calls _safeMint to an owner-supplied address, triggering receiver callbacks.
_safeMint in giveaway invokes onERC721Received on giveOwner, allowing re-entry.
provenanceHash parameter is written by setProvenanceHash.
setProvenanceHash assigns ALTO_PROVENANCE.
baseURI_ parameter is forwarded to the ERC721 base URI setter.
_step parameter is assigned to priceStep.
updatePriceStep writes the priceStep state variable.
timeInSeconds parameter is written into safPriceLifetime.
changeTimer updates safPriceLifetime.
flipSaleState toggles saleIsActive.
increaseMaxSupply is guarded by onlyOwner, checking msg.sender against owner().
withdrawAlto is guarded by onlyOwner and pays the caller msg.sender.
Constructor initializes safPriceTimestamp from block.timestamp, anchoring later price timing logic.
share local is computed in withdrawAlto and split between the owner and backToCommunity().
index local is computed from random() and totalSupply() in backToCommunity.
getPrice derives the price using priceStep.
getPrice caps the computed price with priceCap.

normalization_plan.reason: Mint count argument exists only to drive the mintAlto loop and supply check.
Mint count argument exists only to drive the mintAltoCap loop and payment check.
_amount is the operand of the unchecked maxSupply addition.
giveOwner is only the recipient passed to the mint in giveaway.
_dist only bounds the airdrop mint loop.
provenanceHash is only assigned to ALTO_PROVENANCE by its setter.
baseURI_ is only forwarded to the ERC721 base URI setter.
_step is only assigned to priceStep inside its setter.
timeInSeconds is only assigned to safPriceLifetime inside its setter.
mintIndex is the token id argument of the _safeMint call in mintAlto.
i is only the loop counter of the mintAlto mint loop.
share is the amount split between the two external transfers in withdrawAlto.
index is only used to look up the token owner in backToCommunity.
mintIndex is the token id argument of the _safeMint call in airdrop.
